rationale: New domain: /docs/purchase-request-crosslist.md defines a distinct deliverable (a competitor-OCR crosslist TSV) with a strict output schema, exact reason/match_status strings, and availability/fulfillable formulas. It reuses catalogue matching and branch availability but has its own report contract, so it is atomic as its own BP rather than overloading product_discovery or availability_and_inventory.

dependencies.why: Branch resolution, exact-match rule, spec-label/property-key mapping, the four reason strings, match_status values, formulas, and the exact column schema.
/uploads as the root for the competitor OCR and crosslist TSV inputs.
Same-day availability used for available_today / fulfillable_qty.
Product name and properties for exact matching.

rollback.strategy: Remove the bp_purchase_request_crosslist unit and its render path and its bp_index route.
